thought.description: The thought of the ReAct step, e.g. "I need to find the X-84's current riskScore"

actionName.description:
The tool name of the ReAct step, e.g. "EvaluateStructedDataQuery".
If this step is stored on a {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Example#finalAnswerResult} or
{@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Example#idkResult}, the action name will be replaced with the idk/finalAnswer tool name
used by the agent.

actionInput.description: The input to the tool of the ReAct step, e.g. "X-84's current riskScore"

observation.description:
The optional obervation of the ReAct step, e.g. "The risk score of the X-84 is 0.5".
Not applicable for exit tools (final answers or "I am unable to answer your question")

structuredQuerySpec.description: If the step used a structured query, this is the structured query spec used.

errorMessage.description: The error message that this step produced, if any.

title:
Steps in a {@link Genai.Agent#run} sequence.
Follows the ReAct (Thought, Action Name, Action Input, Observation) framework.
Also used by {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Example}.
name: Genai.Agent.Step
